title: 14-BCV-012 - Interconnected smoke alarms
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
catalogue_status: Catalogue row is not marked [WITHDRAWN]; PDF carries an Archived watermark.

facts.text: The STANDATA addresses wired-interconnection wording in ABC 2014 Sentences 3.2.4.21.(9) and 9.10.19.5.(1)-(2), including houses with secondary suites.
facts.locator: 14-BCV-010 PDF, pp.1-2, CODE REFERENCES and APPLICATION

facts.text: It recognizes a wireless interconnection system as an alternative when the smoke alarm is certified to CAN/ULC-S531; the text also states requirements for permanent power and battery backup.
facts.locator: 14-BCV-010 PDF, p.2, CODE REFERENCES and VARIANCE
